setup: for path in .claude .jactignore .mcp.json .pi .scratch .vscode architecture-principles design-docs .env .env.local .env.development.local .env.test.local .env.production.local; do source_path="$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/$path"; if [ ! -e "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ]; then if [ -L "$source_path" ]; then link_target="$(readlink "$source_path")"; case "$link_target" in /*) ;; *) link_target="$(dirname "$source_path")/$link_target" ;; esac; ln -s "$link_target" "$path"; elif [ -e "$source_path" ]; then ln -s "$source_path" "$path"; fi; fi; done
